facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

control_failures.control_label: integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.title: loss of containment at TK-7102 during commissioning of replacement equipment

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on TK-7102, LT-7102 and PSV-7102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. TK-7102 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 28 April 2023 an incident occurred on TK-7102, LT-7102 and PSV-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
